D: A security guard rebuilt with gadgets becomes a cyborg detective chasing an evil tycoon.
P: Serve the snacks when Gadget finally gets the helicopter hat working.
S: Cherry tomato, mozzarella, salami and basil with olive oil and balsamic
Cherry tomatoes, bocconcini, salami and basil threaded onto skewers, drizzled with olive oil and balsamic.
Riverton soft pretzels with cheese sauce

Soft pretzel knots dipped in bicarb water, sprinkled with rock salt and baked deep brown, with a hot cheddar sauce for dunking. Mix 400g plain flour, 7g dried yeast, 1 tsp sugar, 1 tsp salt and 250ml warm water, knead 8 minutes and prove 1 hour. Shape 8 knots and dip each in 2L boiling water with 60g bicarb soda for 30 seconds. Sprinkle with rock salt and bake at 220C for 12 minutes. Melt 20g butter, stir in 1 tbsp flour, whisk in 250ml milk until thick, then stir in 150g grated cheddar.
Puff pastry rolls with tomato paste, ham and mozzarella, sliced and baked

Puff pastry spread with tomato and oregano, rolled up with ham and mozzarella, sliced into swirls and baked golden and bubbling. Spread 2 sheets of puff pastry with 4 tbsp tomato paste mixed with 1 tsp dried oregano. Scatter with 150g chopped leg ham and 150g grated mozzarella. Roll each sheet up tightly and chill for 15 minutes so it slices cleanly. Cut into 2cm rounds, lay on a lined tray and bake at 200C for 18 minutes until golden.
M: Beef, carrot and celery tomato sauce tossed with spaghetti and parmesan
Spaghetti bolognese with beef mince, carrot, celery and tomato simmered an hour, lots of parmesan on top.
Sanford Scolex, the Claw, in his dark lair

Beef chuck simmered slowly with kidney beans, mild chipotle, cumin and tomato until thick and smoky, with sour cream, cheddar and buttered cornbread. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches. Soften an onion and 3 garlic cloves, add 2 tsp cumin and 1 chopped chipotle in adobo, then a can of crushed tomatoes and 500ml beef stock. Return the beef, cover and simmer 3 hours. Add a drained can of kidney beans for the last 30 minutes. Bake a packet of cornbread mix following the directions. Serve with sour cream and grated cheddar.
W: Vanilla cupcakes with grey icing and chocolate button wheels
Vanilla cupcakes baked at 175C for 18 minutes, topped with grey icing and chocolate wheels.
K: Fresh lemonade topped with soda water and sliced lemon over ice
Fresh lemon juice, sugar syrup and soda water poured over ice with sliced lemon.

s.note: Cherry tomato, mozzarella, salami and basil with olive oil and balsamic
s.how: Thread cherry tomatoes, bocconcini, folded salami and basil leaves onto skewers. Lay on a platter and drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar. Season with salt and pepper. Go go gadget skewers.

s.note: Puff pastry rolls with tomato paste, ham and mozzarella, sliced and baked
s.how: Spread 2 sheets of puff pastry with 4 tbsp tomato paste mixed with 1 tsp dried oregano. Scatter with 150g chopped leg ham and 150g grated mozzarella. Roll each sheet up tightly and chill for 15 minutes so it slices cleanly. Cut into 2cm rounds, lay on a lined tray and bake at 200C for 18 minutes until golden.

m.note: Beef, carrot and celery tomato sauce tossed with spaghetti and parmesan
m.how: Brown 600g beef mince, then add diced carrot and celery and soften. Add 2 cans crushed tomatoes and simmer for an hour, stirring now and then. Toss with 500g cooked spaghetti and cover with plenty of grated parmesan.

w.note: Vanilla cupcakes with grey icing and chocolate button wheels
w.how: Beat 125g butter with 150g sugar, then 2 eggs, then fold in 200g self-raising flour and 125ml milk. Bake at 175C for 18 minutes and cool. Ice with grey icing made from icing sugar with a tiny drop of black, then press on chocolate buttons for wheels.

d.note: Fresh lemonade topped with soda water and sliced lemon over ice
d.how: Dissolve 150g sugar in 150ml hot water and cool. Squeeze 6 lemons into a jug, add the syrup and top with 1L cold soda water. Pour over ice with sliced lemon. Simple and clever, like the real brains of the operation.
